title: Outdoor Smoked Kenyan Chickpea Stew
description: A briny and comforting Kenyan dish featuring birds-eye chillies and bhuna, perfect for a plant-based friendly meal, smoked to perfection on a cedar plank.
instructions: Soak the cedar plank in water for 30 minutes before starting to cook.
In a large bowl, mix together the chickpeas, sliced birds-eye chillies, bhuna spice mix, salt, and black pepper.
Heat the cedar plank over medium heat on an outdoor grill or smoker until it starts to smoke.
Add the chopped onion to the cedar plank and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic to the cedar plank and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the tomato paste to the cedar plank and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the chickpea mixture to the cedar plank and stir to combine with the onion and garlic mixture.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the stew cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the flavors have melded together and the stew has thickened slightly.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro or scallions if desired.
